definitions.explanation: Elastic material obtained from the latex of rubber trees (mainly パラゴムノキ, Hevea brasiliensis). Contrasts with synthetic rubber ({合成|ごうせい}ゴム) made from petrochemicals.

examples.japanese: {天然|てんねん}ゴムの{手袋|てぶくろ}。
このタイヤは{天然|てんねん}ゴムでできている。
examples.english: This tire is made of natural rubber.

examples.japanese: {天然|てんねん}ゴムは{弾力性|だんりょくせい}にとても{優|すぐ}れている。
{天然|てんねん}ゴムは{東南|とうなん}アジアの{熱帯|ねったい}{雨林|うりん}で{育|そだ}つゴムの{木|き}から{採|と}れる。
examples.english: Natural rubber is harvested from rubber trees that grow in the tropical rainforests of Southeast Asia.

notes:
Composed of {天然|てんねん} (natural) and ゴム (rubber, from Dutch {gom}). Written with the second element in katakana because ゴム is a loanword.

USAGE:
- Used as a material noun, typically in attributive form with の: {天然|てんねん}ゴムの{手袋|てぶくろ} (natural rubber gloves).
- Contrasted almost automatically with {合成|ごうせい}ゴム (synthetic rubber) in technical and commercial contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天然|てんねん}ゴムのタイヤ: natural rubber tire
- {天然|てんねん}ゴム{製|せい}: made of natural rubber
- {天然|てんねん}ゴムアレルギー: natural rubber latex allergy
- {天然|てんねん}ゴムを{採取|さいしゅ}する: to harvest natural rubber

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {合成|ごうせい}ゴム: synthetic rubber — made from petrochemicals
- ラテックス: latex — the milky sap from which natural rubber is made, or thin rubber film products
- ゴム: rubber — the general term; may refer to either natural or synthetic
